title: Business Development Executive
description:
Our client, a well-established business within the manufacturing and engineering industry, based in Tewkesbury, has an exciting opportunity for a commercially minded Business Development Executive to join their team on a full-time, permanent basis. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys winning new business, building long-term customer relationships and getting involved in technical projects from the initial conversation through to completion. The role offers plenty of autonomy, with the opportunity to make a real impact on the company's continued growth. Although the company is based in Tewkesbury, requirement to visit the site will be 1 day a week.

The successful Business Development Executive should have:
- A strong sales and business development background, with a proven ability to identify opportunities, win new business and grow existing accounts
- An engineering or manufacturing background, or previous experience selling technical products or services within a B2 B environment
- The ability to read and interpret technical drawings, or a willingness to develop this knowledge
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the confidence to engage with customers, understand their requirements and develop long-term partnerships
- A proactive, commercially driven approach, with the motivation to take ownership of a sales pipeline and see opportunities through from initial enquiry to completion
- The flexibility and willingness to travel extensively across the UK, primarily throughout England, including occasional overnight stays

In this role, the Business Development Executive will be responsible for:
- Proactively identifying and pursuing new business opportunities through outbound calls, networking and targeted sales activity
- Building and maintaining strong relationships with new and existing customers, understanding their requirements and identifying opportunities for future projects
- Working closely with customers to understand their technical requirements, using technical drawings and project specifications to help identify suitable solutions
- Managing the full business development process, from initial contact and quoting through to securing projects and maintaining ongoing customer relationships
- Arranging and attending customer meetings across the UK, both face to face and via Teams, to develop opportunities and strengthen existing partnerships
- Maintaining accurate CRM records, monitoring sales activity and providing regular updates on the sales pipeline and business development progress
- Representing the business at exhibitions, conferences and industry events, while using LinkedIn and other platforms to build a strong professional network and increase brand awareness

This is a predominantly field-based role, with regular travel across the UK, primarily throughout England, to meet customers, develop new opportunities and support projects. When not travelling, the successful candidate will work from the company's Tewkesbury office, with occasional visits to the company's office in Scotland. The role will suit someone who enjoys being out meeting customers, developing opportunities and building relationships over the long term, rather than simply focusing on short-term sales.

Our client is offering the successful Business Development Executive a salary in the region of £45,000, plus an attractive benefits package including uncapped quarterly commission, company car, fuel card, 21 days' holiday plus bank holidays and pension.

If you're a sales-driven professional with an interest in engineering, manufacturing or technical products, and you're looking for an opportunity to take ownership of your own sales pipeline while developing long-term customer relationships and projects, we'd love to hear from you. Whether you already have experience in a technical sales environment or are looking to bring your engineering or manufacturing knowledge into a more commercially focused role, this could be an excellent next step in your career. Apply now to find out more and have an informal chat about the opportunity!

title: Home Sales Consultant - Flooring
description:
Our client, the largest UK retailer of carpets and flooring, are looking for sales-driven and customer-focused individuals to join their expanding team of Home Consultants. Working from your own Mobile Showroom (vehicle provided), you will spend most of your time on the road, working with stores, and visiting customers homes every day.

You will have the opportunity to provide customers with great end-to-end service by helping, advising, and measuring flooring. Using your knowledge of exceptional product ranges and in-house software you will bring customers ideas to life in the comfort of their own home and, while doing so, earn a generous commission!

Outstanding customer service skills will be essential as well as the ability to maximise sales via internet leads by presenting suitable products to the customer in their home.

Full, extensive training provided.

Basic salary of £21,850, with OTE of £40,000 £45,000 including commission, plus a generous range of benefits

title: New Home Sales Advisor
description:
We are working with a private residential developer who is looking to recruit New Homes Sales Advisors to join their team across developments in Gloucestershire and Herefordshire.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced new homes sales professional or someone looking to break into the property industry with a background in sales. The client is open to considering trainees who have the right attitude, communication skills and a genuine interest in property.

The Role:
- Welcoming prospective purchasers to the development and providing an excellent customer experience.
- Conducting viewings and showcasing available properties.
- Building relationships with potential buyers and understanding their requirements.
- Managing enquiries and following up with prospective purchasers to maximise sales opportunities.
- Guiding customers through the purchasing process, from initial enquiry through to reservation.
- Maintaining accurate customer records and keeping sales information up to date.
- Working towards sales targets and contributing to the overall success of the development.

The Ideal Candidate:
- Previous experience in new homes sales or residential property sales would be advantageous.
- Alternatively, candidates with previous sales experience in another sector will be considered for a trainee position.
- Excellent communication and customer service skills.
- A confident, professional and approachable manner.
- A proactive attitude with the motivation to achieve sales targets.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple enquiries.
- A full UK driving licence and access to transport.

What's on Offer?
- The opportunity to join an established private residential developer.
- Opportunities for both experienced sales advisors and those looking to develop a career in property.
- Training and support for candidates entering the new homes sector.
- A competitive salary and the opportunity to earn commission.
- A structured five-day working week, Thursday to Monday, from 9:30am to 5:00pm.

If you have a background in sales and are looking for an opportunity to develop your career within the property industry, or you are an experienced New Homes Sales Advisor seeking your next move, we would love to hear from you.

title: Surgical Medical Sales Representative
company: Wallace Hind Selection LTD - Agency - Permanent
description:
Are you an ambitious medical or business graduate with some tangible medical sales experience? Or are you a Surgical Sales Representative seeking the opportunity to progress further? Either way, we offer full training, and a personalised development plan. You will be selling the best surgical oncology medical implant products in the market!

BASIC SALARY : £45,000 - £50,000

BENEFITS:
Commission on ALL sales (circa 20-25% of Basic Salary in first year), UNCAPPED.
Fleet car during probationary period, then fully-expensed Company Car option.
7% employer pension contribution.
Laptop / Tablet & Mobile Phone.
27 days paid annual leave plus bank holidays, with additional time off for your birthday and long-service milestones.
Work-Life Balance - Trust-based working hours, remote working options.
Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) providing confidential counselling and advice, alongside additional internal support and special leave during significant life events.
Investment in your development through targeted training and continuous learning opportunities.

LOCATION: South-West, including South Wales and elements of the West Midlands.

COMMUTABLE LOCATIONS: Bristol, Bath, Exeter, Gloucester, Wolverhampton, Shrewsbury, Dorset, Cheltenham, Exeter, Swindon, Newport, Oxford, Cardiff, Southampton

JOB DESCRIPTION: Surgical Medical Sales Representative, Territory Sales Manager, Medical Sales - Oncology Implants

We are recruiting a talented and driven individual who possesses the capacity and winning potential to stand out from the crowd.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Surgical Medical Sales Representative, Territory Sales Manager, Medical Sales - Oncology Implants

You will drive new business generation (80%) and develop existing customers (20%), in an established, high-potential territory.
Your job will be highly consultative, based within an operating room environment.
Preparation of quotations and demonstration of equipment.
Full training, development and mentoring provided.
You will also visit fairs and congresses, in order to maximise awareness of our extensive brand portfolio.

PERSON SPECIFICATION: Surgical Medical Sales Representative, Territory Sales Manager, Medical Sales - Oncology Implants

You will be an ambitious medical or business graduate with some surgical sales exposure, or an established medical or surgical sales representative.
Knowledge of NHS purchasing and processes.
A first-class networker, and relationship-builder.
Seeking to progress your sales career in a top-flight company, and in an Oncology surgical hospital sales environment.

OUR COMPANY:

We are at the forefront of the creation and manufacture, of high quality surgical implants used by Consultant Surgeons in the operating room (as well as by other Clinicians in an oncology setting).

As a high-quality business with a strong heritage (over 45 years), our products are both established and respected very highly by Consultant Surgeons & Key Opinion Leaders within Oncology.

Testament to our success is our track record of consistent annual growth.

Naturally we have the ambition and capabilities to compete at the highest levels of both product and clinical excellence.

Our culture is highly progressive while maintaining an entrepreneurial flair. We are very proud of our commercial team, and value each individual.

PROSPECTS:

Wherever possible, we seek to train, develop and promote from within.

It is highly likely you will have worked in any of the following roles and/or markets, and worked with the following products and/or services: Medical Sales, Operating Theatres, Surgical Implants, Oncology, Biomedical Engineer, Biological Materials, Sports Science, Surgical Implants, Territory Sales Executive, Aesthetics, Medical Devices, Medical Consumables, Territory Manager, Orthopaedics, Aesthetics, Surgical, Surgery, Hospital sales, Hospital Specialist, Clinical Applications Specialist.

INTERESTED? Please click apply. You will receive an acknowledgement of your application.

Please Note: Wallace Hind Selection have been chosen as the retained recruitment partner of our client and therefore any direct applications to our client from candidates or agencies will be forwarded on to us direct.

title: Client Service Associate
description:
Client Service Associate

Salary: Up to £30,000

Location: Gloucester

Are you an organised and customer-focused administrator looking to develop your career within financial services? This is an excellent opportunity to join a professional and supportive Client Services team, providing essential administration and client support throughout the financial planning journey.

You'll work closely with Financial Advisers, clients and internal teams, helping to deliver a seamless, efficient and professional service.

The Role

As a Client Service Associate, you will provide day-to-day administrative support to advisers and clients, ensuring client requests are progressed accurately and efficiently.

This is a varied role where attention to detail, communication and a proactive approach are essential. You'll play an important part in maintaining strong client relationships and supporting the wider financial planning process.

Key Responsibilities
- Support Financial Advisers with the day-to-day administration of client cases
- Prepare documentation, obtain policy information and progress client requests
- Manage client communications and provide regular updates on case progress
- Arrange and support adviser-client meetings, including preparing meeting documentation
- Process Letters of Authority (LOAs) and gather information from providers
- Maintain accurate client records and ensure all activities are appropriately documented
- Work collaboratively with colleagues to deliver a seamless client journey
- Prepare cases for handover to the specialist New Business team where required
- Ensure administrative tasks are completed accurately and within agreed timescales

About You
- Previous administrative experience, ideally within financial services
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- Confident communication and relationship-building skills
- A proactive, professional and customer-focused approach
- Ability to work effectively as part of a team
- Experience using Intelligent Office (iO) and Microsoft Office would be advantageous
- Knowledge of financial planning processes and products would be beneficial, but is not essential

Why Apply?

This is a fantastic opportunity to develop your career within financial services, gaining valuable experience across client servicing and financial planning administration.

You'll join a collaborative team where your contribution will be valued, with the opportunity to build your knowledge and progress within the industry.

If you're looking for your next opportunity and enjoy delivering excellent client service, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today via NJR Recruitment or call quoting the reference NJR17125

Please note: Due to a high volume of applications, if your CV does not reflect the essential requirements, or you answer 'no' to key screening questions, we may not be able to contact you.

title: Sales Account Manager
company: Amida Consulting Solutions Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Not every sales role is about chasing cold leads all day, and this one certainly isn't, although that is part of it.

Building relationships, spotting opportunities others miss, and becoming a trusted part of a growing business as well as generating and following up leads are all part of this exciting role.

I am working with an ambitious, purpose-led SME looking to appoint their first dedicated Sales Account Manager. Already well-established within their market, the business has built a strong reputation, a loyal customer base and a substantial database of contacts. They now need someone with the drive, resilience and commercial instinct to help unlock the opportunities already sitting in front of them, whilst creating new ones.

This is a newly created position reporting directly to the Managing Director, offering the chance to play a key role in the next stage of the company's growth.

You will inherit a large database of existing and previous customers, giving you plenty of opportunities to build relationships, re-engage dormant accounts and identify new commercial opportunities.

Alongside this, you will be responsible for developing new business through proactive outreach and relationship building.

This isn't a role for someone who waits for opportunities to land in their inbox. It will suit somebody who enjoys opening doors, starting conversations and maintaining momentum.

You'll hear "no" regularly, but you'll also understand that success is often a numbers game. The ability to stay positive, keep activity levels high and consistently build relationships will be key.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will be:
- Generating new business opportunities through outbound activity.
- Managing and developing existing customer relationships.
- Identifying opportunities to increase revenue and profitability.
- Re-engaging dormant accounts.
- Building and maintaining a healthy sales pipeline.
- Preparing quotations and proposals.
- Negotiating commercial agreements.
- Maintaining accurate CRM records.
- Working closely with the Managing Director to support business growth.
- Contributing ideas to improve sales performance and customer engagement.

I am less interested in industry background and more interested in mindset.

You may currently be working in sales, account management, business development, recruitment, professional services or another relationship-led B2 B environment and will be:
- Driven to earn commission, not be comfortable on your basic salary.
- Experienced in a B2 B sales or account management role.
- Comfortable generating new business opportunities.
- A strong communicator who enjoys building long-term relationships.
- Commercially aware and naturally curious.
- Organised and self-motivated.
- Resilient when faced with rejection.
- Professional, consultative and never overly pushy.
- Excited by the idea of helping a growing SME achieve ambitious goals.

In this exciting role you will have direct access to senior leadership and the opportunity to shape a newly created role as well as having genuine progression opportunities as the business grows.

This is a rare opportunity to join a growing business at a pivotal stage of its journey.

If you're looking for a role where your efforts will be recognised, your ideas will be welcomed, and your impact will be genuinely visible, I love to hear from you.

Amida Solutions is committed to promoting equality, diversity and inclusion. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates and will consider all applicants based on their skills, experience and potential, regardless of background or personal characteristics.
